title: How User Language Affects Conflict Fatality Estimates in ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Automated querying of GPT-3.5 about conflict airstrike fatalities using translated prompts in the languages of the attacker and the targeted group (Hebrew vs. Arabic, Turkish vs. Kurdish). The outputs were then back-translated to English to quantitatively compare numeric fatality estimates, rates of evasive responses, and word frequencies (e.g., mentions of civilians, human rights) across the different languages.
